items.title: 61427_Happy Caldwell oral history interview
items.q: Jelly said, well, we going to have an audition with Mr. Schiffman down at the Apollo Theater. All right, Jelly, Johnny. So we got the thing together.

ctx.x: Oh, that's around the time you recorded with him.

Yeah, 1939. We recorded it on the (unintelligible) recording. So Jelly, (unintelligible) was (unintelligible) right next to where I lived at 209, because the house I lived in, Jelly lived in for years, so Jelly said, well, we going to have an audition with Mr. Schiffman down at the Apollo Theater. All right, Jelly, Johnny. So we got the thing together. Jelly Johnny had a few numbers, said, Hap, got a new number, (unintelligible). I said, well, what is it, Jelly Johnny? "Finger Buster" -- Jelly Johnny got on there…

He was experienced. So we got the thing together, said, we're going to make this audition. We'll make it down at the Apollo Parlor Theater, the (unintelligible) rehearsal hall downstairs next door. We got down there, got everything set up. David Nelson's trumpet player. He's a nephew of Joe Oliver Geronimo, yeah. He's from New Orleans too. So we got down there, we played some numbers, and Mr. Shipley said, that's fine, gentlemen.
